description: This file defines the ApiProvider class, which provides mechanisms to retrieve, resolve, and manage API data for AWS services within the SDK. It includes methods for resolving API providers, loading API data from directories or manifests, and handling API versioning.

classes.name: ApiProvider
classes.description: Provides mechanisms to load, resolve, and manage AWS API models, supporting versioning, directory-based models, and fallback options.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves an API provider and ensures a non-null return value; throws UnresolvedApiException if data cannot be retrieved.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Returns a default API provider instance that loads data from the pre-built manifest.

methods.name: manifest
methods.description: Creates an API provider configured with a specific service model directory and manifest data.

methods.name: filesystem
methods.description: Creates an API provider that loads API data directly from a directory containing service models.

methods.name: getVersions
methods.description: Returns available API versions for a given service.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Executes the provider to retrieve API data for specific type, service, and version; returns null if not found.

methods.name: buildVersionsList
methods.description: Builds a list of available versions for a service by globbing the directory.
